note: The batch registry (PREREGISTRATION.md §2.10): the run-time pins the wrapper stamps per slot, the scorer recomputes, and harness/integrity.py verifies before any call and any count. Members whose registered moment has not arrived are null and say so; an all-zero digest is a port in progress and refuses.

python.note: Implementation and series enforced; the running interpreter's full version is reported by integrity at run time, deliberately not pinned here (round 3, finding 20).

assembledPreamble.note: 010's preamble with PREAMBLE_DELTA [D-16] applied at its single occurrence; re-derived and checked both ways by integrity.verify_arms().

conventionsDelta.note: The one sentence [D-15] appends to 010's conventions paragraph, leading space included.

claim.note: The verbatim published wording of R1, its venues, URLs and retrieval date (§1). Two records: 011's MIRROR-AGREEMENT.md §(d) at the commit-pinned URL (the pre-stated directional prediction), and issue #45 (the restatement carrying both halves).

probePrompt.note: 011's probe, byte-identical; the authority is 011's PINS.json (tier 2).

order.construction: W1-W5 increment every symbol A->B->C->D->E per row; W6-W10 are those rows reversed

batch.note: §2.8's registered call order; harness/tests/test_schedule.py re-derives the five balance properties and requires batch.schedule() to equal the expansion.

golden.note: The recaptured golden context (§3.2, one capture for all five arms); null until the capture is registered.

isolationNegative.note: §6 C7 runs once, against the operator's real home, only with recorded operator assent; batch.py capture-isolation-negative refuses while this is null.

freeze.note: §2.10 [D-20]: both digests filled at their registered moments and null until then. The exclusion list is the registered files-that-cannot-exist-yet set, at the paths the code actually writes (round 3, findings 1-2, dispositioned); the manifest's two carrier files (harness/PINS.json, PREREG-REVIEW.md) are excluded in integrity.tree_manifest() itself.

registryOfRecord: The committed harness/PINS.json is the registry of record: the wrapper stamps the digest of the registry it ran under, the scorer computes the committed file's digest itself, and any slot whose stamp differs is registry-mismatch. The scorer takes no registry argument at all (§2.10 [D-23]).

thresholdDefinitionSentence.note: The one sentence arm E's conventions paragraph appends to the shared A-D paragraph (§2.6, [D-3]); pinned so C8 checks byte equality, not shape (round 3, finding 7).
